node.title: L1 tangent double-root descent to a primitive shell
node.statement: Fix an exact tangent owner D=gcd(L,Q) of degree r in U-P=LQ. If 2r<=k, let P_D=U mod D^2 and W_D=(U-P_D)/D^2. Then P=P_D+D^2R bijects the exact-D tangent stratum with the primitive exact shell of W_D on the punctured domain H\roots(D), with parameters (n-r,k-2r,a-r,e-r,w+r); exact ownership plus the complement guard is exactly gcd(Q_0,Omega/D)=1 in the reduced shell. If 2r>k, one D supports at most one codeword. The punctured domain need not remain smooth and no sum over D is asserted.
